newsitem.title: USA: Stolt Comex reports contract awards.
newsitem.headline: Stolt Comex reports contract awards.

text.p: Stolt Comex Seaway SA said Tuesday it has been awarded two new contracts, one involving flowline installation in the North Sea and the other for field development work in offshore West Africa.

The first contract is for the Oryx Energy Co for the supply and installation of 7.7 kilometers of 6 inch NKT flexible flowline, in 150 meters of water, to provide fuel gas for the Hutton Tension Leg Platform, together with a flexible riser and subsea installation valve.
This contract, valued at $8 million, will be carried out in April 1997.
The contract is the first for which NKT Holding A/S's NKT Cables will supply the flowline, Stolt Comex said in a statement released in New York.
This award "is an endorsement of our strategic alliance with NKT Cables, established in August 1995," Stolt said.

The second is from Elf Aquitaine's Elf Exploration Angola for the drilling and tie-back of two new wells on the Oombo field in 100 meters of water, 50 kilometers offshore Angola. It was awarded to a consortium of Stolt and Brasoil, the overseas trading arm of Petrobras.

Under this contract Brasoil will drill and complete the wells and Stolt will undertake the installation of rigid flowlines, umbilicals, risers, control systems and subsea structures. The value of this contract to the SCS Brasoil consortium is $35 million and the work will take place in 1997. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
